_comment: An Element's display is written FLAT on the element, so its own keys and the
fields of an Appearance share ONE namespace on the wire. This file is the
single place that namespace is written down; the editor suite and the plugin
suite both read it, so adding an appearance field that shadows a structural
key fails a test instead of silently winning at parse time.
Anything at the element level that is NOT in `structural` is a display field.
